conbody.p: The USE_HBO_STATS query option determines whether Impala uses stored historical cardinality data during query planning.

When enabled, the planner checks the History Based Optimization (HBO) cache for matching historical runs. If matching statistics exist for supported plan nodes (e.g., ScanNode, AggregationNode, UnionNode, or JoinNode), the planner applies those cardinality stats to refine the query plan.

ul.li: You can enable USE_HBO_STATS and STORE_HBO_STATS independently. Enable STORE_HBO_STATS to collect and store statistics, and enable USE_HBO_STATS to read and apply stored statistics during query planning. Enable both options to fully participate in history-based plan optimization.
Verify whether cardinality statistics were read from HBO by inspecting the query profile or EXPLAIN output. Plan nodes using cached statistics display a "from HBO" annotation.

conbody.p: Run the following command to enable reading HBO statistics for the current session:SET USE_HBO_STATS=true;
